company.name: Sirka
company.shortDescription: Sirka is Indonesia's First Metabolic Clinic
company.description:
Sirka is leading healthcare innovation as Indonesia's first metabolic clinic. We offer a tech-enabled, holistic approach to managing obesity and metabolic health. We are deeply committed to transforming lives by addressing the root causes of weight gain, chronic diseases, and related health complications.

Our services focus on weight management, digestive health, diabetes care, and chronic disease management. We provide personalized and clinically proven programs tailored to individual needs. We combine expert medical care, customized nutrition plans, and continuous monitoring to ensure each client receives the support they need for long-term success.

Whether seeking weight loss solutions or managing chronic conditions like diabetes, Sirka is here to provide accessible, convenient, and effective healthcare. Our services empower Indonesians to live healthier, longer lives, with benefits such as improved weight management and better control over chronic diseases.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,477,514 to $12,967,565, a 5.23x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 24 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
